title: SqlClient
description: The ADO.NET data provider for SQL Server, supporting Always Encrypted and Always On.

data.text: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient is the ADO.NET data provider for SQL Server. It enables applications to connect to and interact with SQL Server databases, supporting Always Encrypted, Always On, and Azure Active Directory authentication.

data.title: Connecting and Querying
data.content: Connect to SQL Server and retrieve data.

terms.definition: The ADO.NET data provider for SQL Server.
A feature that encrypts sensitive data within client applications.

data.title: Security
data.text: Always use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection attacks.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: SqlClient is the standard SQL Server provider for .NET
Includes Always Encrypted and Azure AD auth
data.takeaway: SqlClient provides comprehensive SQL Server connectivity for .NET.
